WITH step1 AS (
  SELECT signals.rfistat, AVG(signals.modindex) as avg_modindex
  FROM signals
  GROUP BY signals.rfistat
),
step2 AS (
  SELECT AVG(signals.modindex) as overall_avg
  FROM signals
),
step3 AS (
  SELECT step1.rfistat, step1.avg_modindex, step1.avg_modindex - step2.overall_avg as diff
  FROM step1, step2
  WHERE step1.avg_modindex > step2.overall_avg
    AND step2.overall_avg IS NOT NULL
),
step4 AS (
  SELECT AVG(step3.avg_modindex) as avg_of_avgs
  FROM step3
)
SELECT step3.rfistat, step3.avg_modindex, step3.diff, step3.avg_modindex - step4.avg_of_avgs as final_diff
FROM step3, step4
WHERE step4.avg_of_avgs IS NOT NULL
